title: PersonenstandsgesetzDynasticSpoilsRestitution
description: Formal JSON Schema for SPEC-PERSONENSTANDSGESETZ-PRIVACY-FIREWALL-AND-DYNASTIC-SPOILS-RESTITUTION-v1.0 modeling the Personenstandsgesetz Sec. 5 registry lock horizons, continuous-compounding dynastic spoils identities, Rosenburg / NARA RG 242 / Berlin Document Center evidentiary anchors, registry disambiguation collision algebra, and present-tense adult ratification scoring.

pstg_birth_lock_years.description: PStG Sec. 5 birth-register lock horizon in years (binding maximum lock).

pstg_marriage_lock_years.description: PStG Sec. 5 marriage-register lock horizon in years.

pstg_death_lock_years.description: PStG Sec. 5 death-register lock horizon in years.

generation_span_years.description: Standard generational span in years used to normalize lock horizons.

shielded_generations_ratio.description: Birth lock divided by generation span: full dynastic generations shielded from registry disclosure.

guilt_counter_at_birth.description: Axiom: descendants inherit zero personal guilt at birth; liability attaches to the capital, not the person.

initial_cartel_capital_usd.description: Initial cartel capital principal in USD seeded at the start of the shielded horizon.

annual_compounding_rate.description: Continuous annual compounding rate r applied over the shielded horizon.

compounding_horizon_years.description: Compounding horizon T in years spanning the registry-locked interval.

clean_slate_reputation_premium_usd.description: Reputation premium monetized by the clean-slate identity under continued concealment.

free_option_secrecy_payoff_usd.description: Free-option secrecy payoff = compounded spoils + clean-slate reputation premium.

disgorgement_liability_under_concealment.description: Restitution floor: disgorgement liability under concealment equals the compounded spoils.

rosenburg_nsdap_jurist_share.description: Peak share of former NSDAP-member jurists in the post-war Federal Ministry of Justice per the Rosenburg study.

nara_rg242_nsdap_cards.description: NSDAP membership cards held in NARA Record Group 242 (Berlin Document Center collection).

bdc_embargo_battle_years.description: Berlin Document Center embargo span in years: 1994 custody transfer minus 1945 seizure.

unscr_276_year.description: UN Security Council Resolution 276 adoption year.

swakopmund_enclave_year.description: Swakopmund enclave year; must strictly postdate UNCR 276.

raw_surname_candidates.description: Raw surname-only candidate pool before registry disambiguation.

dob_disambiguation_factor.description: Date-of-birth disambiguation factor (days in the 20-year cohort window).

joint_disambiguation_space.description: Joint disambiguation space = DOB factor x municipality factor.

expected_collision_rate_4tuple.description: Expected collision rate for the surname x DOB x municipality 4-tuple lookup.

maiden_name_disambiguation_factor.description: Maiden-name disambiguation factor contributed by the marriage register.

expected_collision_rate_5tuple.description: Expected collision rate after adding the maiden-name axis to the 5-tuple lookup.

deterministic_precision_5tuple.description: Deterministic identification precision of the 5-tuple: 1 minus the 5-tuple collision rate.

adult_ratification_vector.description: 4-dimensional binary indicator vector for present-tense adult ratification (1: Carl Schmitt Ausnahmezustand endorsement, 2: Southern Trust LP bridge retention, 3: Roatan ZEDE Grossraum financing, 4: St. Kitts 28-subject trial capitalization and board seat).

adult_ratification_score.description: Present-tense adult ratification score: 4 of 4 operational dimensions ratified.
